decision: Use @qvac/sdk 0.18.2 for compatibility with the explicitly supplied shared team runtime.

basis.reason: The team pins 0.18.2 because its broader project supports delegated P2P inference. Clinical PsyRec execution remains local-only and rejects delegation.

verifiedComparison.expo: The official tutorial says npm i @qvac/sdk; its older sample dependency block uses ^0.7.0. It does not impose 0.18.2.
verifiedComparison.sdk0182: Published package tarball inspected in memory: contains VisionPsy base and Flash constants, image_no_upscale, emittedTokens, generatedTokens, promptTokens, timeToFirstToken; monolithic dist/server/worker.js and llm addon ^0.45.0.
verifiedComparison.sdk0190: Separates @qvac/inference and removes delegated inference. Different worker lifecycle import and worker entry path. Installed API research established local-only named-pipe execution.
verifiedComparison.modelPair: Both SDKs support the base weights and matching projector. Base requires image_no_upscale unset.

clinicalBoundary: TypeScript adapts the existing cargar/completar/registrar contracts with exact prompts, validated native performance fields, local verified files, no KV persistence, isolated worker cleanup, and an encrypted evidence sink.
validationScope: This version rationale is not a performance or clinical workflow result; actual inference evidence is retained in separate synthetic run files.
